Last updated: 23 November 2026 · Policy version 1

Privacy policy

  • Sirrak is an on-device assistant: chats, documents, models and settings stay in app-private storage.
  • The only network feature is a model download you explicitly start. There is no telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting, no ads and no account.
  • Offline-only mode is enforced before any socket opens and cancels a running download.

What stays on your device

  • Chats, prompts and answers are stored in app-private storage on your phone.
  • Documents you add to the Library (PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown and text) and their extracted text, chunks and embedding vectors stay in app-private storage.
  • Model files you download or import are stored in app-private storage.
  • Settings, including the offline-only switch, are stored on the device.
  • The network log lists the calls this app actually made on this device. It is stored locally, bounded to the 50 newest entries, and is never uploaded.
  • AI-output reports you create are stored locally, bounded to 50 reports; they leave the device only when you tap Share and choose an app in the Android chooser.

What leaves your device

Sirrak has exactly one network feature today: downloading a model that you explicitly start.

  • The request goes to the host shown in Settings → Privacy & data → Network log (currently huggingface.co, the model's public resolver).
  • The request contains the model file path you chose, a standard user agent and — only if you typed a token for a gated model — that token. No chat text, prompt, document, report or device identifier is sent with it.
  • There are no analytics, no crash reporting, no ads, no tracking and no remote accounts.
  • When offline-only is on, the app refuses every new request and cancels a running download; chat, dictation, document search and reports keep working.

Permissions

  • Internet and network state: model downloads and the Wi-Fi-only default.
  • Microphone: only while you start or hold dictation.
  • Notifications: download progress for a download you started (optional; the download also runs without it where Android allows).
  • No location, contacts, phone or SMS permissions. Images and documents are only read through the Android system picker or camera intent after you choose them.

Retention and deletion

  • Delete a chat, document or model from inside the app; deleting a model removes its file from app-private storage.
  • The network log and AI-output reports each have a clear action and a bounded size.
  • Uninstalling the app deletes all app-private data.

Children

Sirrak is a general-purpose tool, not directed at children, and it does not collect personal data.

Changes to this policy

This policy is versioned with the app (current version: 1, 23 November 2026). Material changes will be shown in the app before they take effect, and this page will keep the same URL.

Contact

Privacy questions: open an issue at github.com/alshahia/sirrak/issues labelled privacy. Security problems: use the private advisory form on the security page — never a public issue.
